name: web_search
description: Search the public web for current or general information and return the most relevant results. Use for news, prices, facts, definitions, or anything that is not stored in the internal company database.

query.description: The search query, phrased as concise keywords or a short question.

name: db_query
description: Answer a question from the internal company database (customers, orders, products, employees, meetings) by asking it in plain English. Use for internal or business data, never for public information.

question.description: The question to answer from the database, in natural language.

name: delegate
description: Hand a complex, multi-step task to a stronger assistant that can plan, use many tools and come back with a summary. Use it when the request needs several steps or research beyond a single lookup.

task.description: The task to hand over, in one sentence.
